content: Once we expose vm mapping/unmapping to userspace with the ioctl series from @Alvin Sun , sashiko is i think correctly pointing out that Tyr will trigger a kernel WARN if userspace attempts to unmap 4KiB within a 2MiB huge page. https://sashiko.dev/#/message/sashiko-outbox-204272%40kernel.org Both tyr-dev and panthor handle this by aligning the unmap region to 2MiB and then remapping the revised prev/next. I'm thinking that we have to fix this in Tyr before the ioctl series can land? @Alice Ryhl
